takeaways.text: Comparable sales rose 5.7% (8.0% excluding gasoline prices and currency moves), and e-commerce sales grew 14.8%.
takeaways.title: Shoppers kept coming

takeaways.text: Fees rose 10% to $1.24B — nearly half of Costco's $2.53B operating income came from what members pay before they buy anything.
takeaways.title: Membership fees are the profit engine

takeaways.text: Costco ended the quarter with 905 warehouses, including 624 in the United States and Puerto Rico.
takeaways.title: Still expanding

verdict: Costco's net sales rose 8% to $62.0B as comparable sales climbed 5.7% — and $1.24B of nearly cost-free membership fees helped lift profit 13% to $1.9B.
